title: Automotive Service Advisor
description:
Automotive Service Advisor / Motor Trade Service Advisor

Location: Chelmsford, Essex

Salary: 28,000 - 34,000 per annum (depending on experience)

Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 5:30pm, plus one Saturday morning per month

Are you an experienced Automotive Service Advisor looking for a new opportunity within the motor trade?

We're recruiting on behalf of an established, award-winning independent automotive specialist in Chelmsford that's looking for a confident, organised and customer-focused Service Advisor to join its team. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys being at the heart of a busy automotive workshop, building relationships with customers and ensuring everything runs smoothly from the initial booking through to vehicle collection.

You'll play an important role in connecting customers with the workshop team, managing service and repair bookings, preparing quotations and helping customers understand the work required on their vehicles.

If you have previous experience within a main dealership, prestige automotive specialist or independent garage, we'd love to hear from you.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of 28,000 - 34,000, depending on experience
- Permanent, full-time employment
- Opportunity to join an established, award-winning independent automotive business
- Varied role combining customer service, workshop coordination and automotive knowledge
- 22 days annual leave plus bank holidays
- Company pension scheme
- Employee discounts
- Private Healthcare
- Free on-site parking

Key Responsibilities
- Act as the first point of contact for customers, providing a friendly and professional service.
- Manage vehicle servicing, maintenance and repair bookings by telephone and online.
- Coordinate the workshop diary, working closely with technicians and workshop management.
- Prepare accurate quotations and estimates for servicing, repairs and additional work.
- Review Vehicle Health Checks (VHCs), clearly explaining any recommended repairs or maintenance to customers.
- Identify and source the correct vehicle parts, ensuring accurate pricing and labour estimates.
- Keep customers informed throughout the repair process, providing updates on progress and completion times.
- Recommend additional servicing and repair work where appropriate, helping maximise workshop efficiency and sales.
- Ensure customer records, bookings and job information are maintained accurately.
- Work closely with colleagues to maintain excellent customer satisfaction and smooth day-to-day workshop operations.

What We're Looking For
- At least 3 years' experience as a Service Advisor within the motor trade.
- Previous experience within a main dealership, independent garage or prestige automotive specialist.
- Good understanding of vehicle servicing, maintenance and mechanical repairs.
- Experience preparing repair quotations, processing Vehicle Health Checks and estimating labour requirements.
- Confidence communicating with customers about vehicle faults, repairs and recommended maintenance.
- Excellent customer service and communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple bookings and enquiries.
- Good attention to detail and confidence using workshop booking or dealer management systems.
- A proactive, positive attitude and the ability to work effectively within a busy automotive environment.

Previous automotive Service Advisor experience is essential for this position.

Interested?

If you're an experienced Automotive Service Advisor, Motor Trade Service Advisor or Vehicle Service Advisor looking for a new opportunity in Chelmsford, we'd love to hear from you.

Whether you're currently working in a busy main dealership or an independent automotive workshop, this could be an excellent opportunity to join an established business where your experience and customer service skills will be valued.

Apply today to find out more about the position and discuss the opportunity in confidence.

title: HR & Training Coordinator
description:
Job Title: Training/HR Coordinator
Location: Chelmsford

Are you passionate about driving employee development in the manufacturer sector? Our client, a dynamic and forward-thinking engineering organisation, is seeking a proactive and enthusiastic Training/HR Coordinator to elevate their training programmes and HR initiatives. This is a fantastic opportunity to contribute to a thriving workplace culture and support the growth of talent within the organisation.

Key Responsibilities:
- Coordinate and manage training programmes to enhance employee skills and professional development.
- Collaborate with department heads to identify training needs and design tailored learning solutions.
- Maintain training records and evaluate the effectiveness of training programmes.
- Assist in the development and implementation of HR policies and procedures that align with the organisation's goals.
- Support recruitment efforts by coordinating interviews and managing onboarding processes.
- Foster a positive employee experience through effective communication and engagement initiatives.

What Our Client Offers:
- A vibrant workplace where innovation meets collaboration.
- Opportunities for professional growth and development.
- A supportive team environment that values employee contributions.
- Competitive salary and benefits package.

Ideal Candidate Profile:
- Previous experience in training coordination or HR roles, preferably within the engineering sector.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to engage with employees at all levels.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving and a keen eye for detail.
- Familiarity with HR software and training management systems is a plus.

Why This Role is Exciting:

The Training/HR Coordinator role offers a unique chance to make a significant impact on the workforce of a leading engineering organisation. By facilitating continuous learning and development, the successful candidate will play a crucial role in shaping the future of the company's talent pool. This position not only allows for personal growth but also provides the satisfaction of seeing employees thrive and succeed.

If you are ready to embark on an exciting journey with a company that prioritises growth, innovation, and employee well-being, this could be the perfect role for you!

How to Apply:

Interested candidates are encouraged to submit their CV and a covering letter outlining their relevant experience and motivation for applying. This is an exceptional opportunity to join a company that values talent and is committed to fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Don't miss the chance to be part of a remarkable team that is shaping the future of engineering in Chelmsford! Apply today and take the next step in your career journey!

title: Temporary HR Administrator/PA
description:
HR Administrator & PA Chelmsford 18 per hour Ongoing Temporary Assignment

Your new company

A well-established and highly regarded organisation based in Chelmsford is seeking an experienced HR Administrator & PA to join their team on an ongoing temporary basis. This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and professional administrator who enjoys working in a varied role, supporting both HR operations and senior leadership. The role is based in a modern office with free on-site parking and offers hybrid working once training has been completed.

Your new role
Reporting to the HR Manager, with additional support responsibilities to the Managing Director, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth running of HR administration and executive support activities.

Key responsibilities will include:
- Supporting all aspects of the employee life cycle, including onboarding, employee changes and leavers.
- Maintaining accurate HR records, databases and personnel files.
- Managing absence administration and annual leave records.
- Coordinating training activities and employee engagement initiatives.
- Acting as a first point of contact for HR-related enquiries.
- Providing confidential PA support to the Managing Director.
- Diary management, meeting coordination and travel arrangements.
- Preparing reports, presentations and correspondence.
- Taking meeting minutes and following up on actions.
- Supporting leadership meetings and company events.

What you'll need to succeed

To be successful in this role, you will have previous experience within HR Administration, HR Assistant, Executive Assistant, Personal Assistant or a similar administrative position. You will possess excellent organisational skills, strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Experience handling confidential information and strong Microsoft Office skills are essential. HR systems experience and a CIPD qualification would be advantageous.

What you'll get in return
- 18 per hour
- Immediate start available
- Ongoing temporary assignment with the potential to continue until a permanent appointment is made
- Monday to Friday, 8:30am to 5:00pm, with flexibility around working hours
- Initially office-based five days per week for training and onboarding
- Hybrid working available once fully trained
- Free on-site parking
- Friendly and supportive working environment

What you need to do now

If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or contact Sarah Stone at Hays for a confidential discussion.
